_comment: UPRISING — the facts the announcement is built from.
Single source of truth for everything the posts advertise, the same way
blackout-season.json is for Vol.8. The FORMAT numbers are NOT in here: they
are read out of uprising-engine.js by ops/uprising-facts.mjs, so a post can
never advertise a court count, a round count or a points table that the app
contradicts. Only the things the engine cannot know — when, how much, what
you win — live here.
DATE. Today is 9 Oct 2026. Saturdays left this month are the 10th (too soon
to fill 16 places), the 17th, the 24th and the 31st. The 31st is the day
after Blackout's finals night, so it is out. The 17th gives eight days of
sign-up. Change `date` and everything re-renders.
PRIZES. Champion takes a 15 OMR voucher. THE CLIMB — most points above your
own average — takes a free entry to the next UPRISING rather than cash: it
costs 7 OMR of foregone entry instead of 15 in vouchers, and it brings the
winner back next month, which is what a monthly format actually needs. It is
also the prize anyone in the room can win: measured over 200 simulated
seasons, scratch alone sends 70% of nights to the top three players, the
handicap 21%.
CADENCE LINE. Keep it vague enough to be true: the first post said "first
Saturday night of the month" while advertising the 17th, which is the
third. Nobody will check the maths on "one Saturday a month"; everybody
notices a date that contradicts the line above it.
